description: This file defines an interface 'IControllable' for controllable components within the Orleans runtime, including a method 'ExecuteCommand' for executing control commands asynchronously.

classes.name: IControllable
classes.description: An interface representing controllable components that can execute commands asynchronously.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes a control command with a given command identifier and argument, returning a task with the result.
